title: Music concert, 500-drone and light show to feature LPL opening | Daily FT
summary:
Wednesday, 15 July 2026 00:02
-     - 12

Reigning champions Jaffna Kings

The Lanka Premier League 2026 is set to begin in spectacular fashion on 17 July at SSC grounds, with a grand opening ceremony designed to bring together cricket, entertainment, technology and national pride in one high-energy stadium experience.

The opening night will mark the start of the sixth edition of Sri Lanka’s domestic T20 tournament with international flavour and is expected to create one of the most memorable launch moments in the history of the LPL. With live performances, official ceremonial moments, team introductions, a grand trophy reveal and a landmark 500-drone show, the ceremony is being positioned as an experience cricket fans should not miss.

The evening will feature performances by some of Sri Lanka’s most recognized entertainment names, including Yohani, Sanka Dineth and Centigradz. Yohani is expected to bring international appeal to the LPL stage with her global hit “Manike Mage Hithe”, while Sanka Dineth and Centigradz will add further energy, familiarity and local flavour to the opening night.

A key highlight of the evening will be the official commencement of LPL 2026, with Lanka Premier League Tournament Director Samantha Dodanwela expected to formally declare the tournament open. This will be followed by a grand trophy reveal, one of the most anticipated moments of the ceremony, designed as a premium visual moment for fans inside the stadium and audiences watching across television and digital platforms.

The ceremony will also include team introductions, giving fans the opportunity to welcome the five competing franchises as they begin their campaigns for the 2026 season. The segment is expected to bring colour, energy and franchise pride to the stadium, building excitement ahead of the first match of the tournament.

To elevate the spectacle further, a 500-drone light show will light up the Colombo sky with LPL branding, cricket visuals, national pride and team-inspired formations. The drone show is expected to create strong audience impact and memorable visual moments, while giving LPL 2026 the feel of a major global sporting event.

Commenting on the opening ceremony, IPG Founder and Chairman Anil Mohan said, “LPL 2026 is being designed as more than a cricket tournament. It is a complete fan experience. The opening ceremony on 17 July will bring together sport, entertainment and technology in a way that celebrates Sri Lanka and gives fans a powerful reason to be part of the first night. We want the opening ceremony to set the tone for a season filled with energy, excitement and world-class cricket.”

Lanka Premier League Tournament Director Samantha Dodanwela said, “The opening ceremony is an important moment in every LPL season because it brings players, franchises and fans together before the cricket begins. This year’s ceremony has been planned to create a strong sense of occasion around the tournament, while celebrating the growing stature of the league. We look forward to welcoming fans to SSC Colombo for what promises to be a memorable start to LPL 2026.”

With the first match and opening ceremony taking place at the SSC, LPL 2026 will bring franchise cricket excitement to the heart of the city. Cricket lovers, families and franchise supporters are encouraged to secure their tickets early and be part of a landmark opening night that will combine the thrill of T20 cricket with a world-class entertainment experience. First match of the season is scheduled to start at 7.45 pm and the gates will open to the public by 5 pm. The opening ceremony will kick start at 6.15 pm.

The Lanka Premier League 2026 will run from 17 July to 8 August featuring five competitive franchises, leading Sri Lankan cricketers and international T20 talent.

title: Wekunagoda (233) becomes  Sri Lanka’s highest individual scorer | Daily FT
summary:
Wednesday, 15 July 2026 00:00
-     - 8

Senuja Wekunagoda became the highest individual scorer for Sri Lanka in an Under19 Youth Test when he carved a monumental 233 on the second day of the first Under19 Youth Test against India at the Galle International Cricket Stadium yesterday.

Wekunagoda who was undefeated on 203 overnight went past Yashodha Lanka’s 15-year-old record of 213 scored against England U19 at the P Sara Oval, taking 23 balls to move to 214 and become the new record holder for his country. His 267-ball knock was finally ended when off-spinner Jeganathan Hemchudeshan breached his defence to bowl him for 233. The innings comprised 33 fours and a six, which was another new Sri Lankan record for the most runs in boundaries (138) surpassing Dinesh Chandimal’s 112 (28 fours) against Bangladesh U19 at Fatullah in 2009.

Once the partnership of 111 for the fifth wicket between Wekunagoda and Chamika Heenatigala (45) was broken, wickets took a tumble as Sri Lanka collapsed from 385-4 to 388-9 losing five for three runs. It was poor batting by the late order to hand the advantage back to India after being on top till the 98th over.

If not for last man Oshada Manahara, the 17-year-old from DS Senanayake College who played a cameo innings of 31* off 12 balls (4 fours, 2 sixes) Sri Lanka would not have got over the 400-run mark. They closed their innings at 424-9. Hemchudeshan with three wickets yesterday was the pick of the bowlers ending with 3/107 off 24 overs.

With the track not giving the bowlers much assistance India mounted their reply in grand style with their openers Lakshya Raichandani and Sagar Virk posting 186 without loss. Raichandani was unbeaten on 93, scored off 136 balls (10 fours, 2 sixes) and Virk on 87* off 215 balls (12 fours). India trail Sri Lanka by 238 runs with all ten first innings wickets in hand. Play continues on its third day today. – [ST]

Scores: Sri Lanka (U19) 424-9 decl. (o/n 344-4) (Senuja Wekunagoda 233, Vimath Dinsara 52, Kavija Gamage 49, Chamika Heenatigala 45, Oshada Manahara 31*, Kavya Patel 2/67, Jeganathan Hemchudeshan 3/107, Priyanshu Singh 2/66) vs. India (U19) 186-0 at close (Lakshya Raichandani 93*, Sagar Virk 87*)

title: Vietjet honoured among Asia’s Best Companies to Work For ahead of Colombo route launch | Daily FT
summary:
Wednesday, 15 July 2026 00:05
-     - 9

As Vietjet prepares to launch direct flights between Colombo and Ho Chi Minh City, the airline’s people-first culture is earning fresh international recognition. 

Vietjet has been named again as one of the Best Companies to Work For in Asia at the HR Asia Awards 2026, marking its sixth consecutive year on the list, and has also picked up its first HR Asia Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DE&I) Award.

Organised annually by HR Asia, the awards recognise organisations with outstanding human resource practices, high employee engagement and strong workplace culture across the region. The 2026 list of honourees also includes leading companies in Vietnam, with Vietjet standing out for its sustained efforts to foster a professional, engaging and inspiring working environment.

This year, Vietjet was recognised for the first time with the HR Asia DE&I Award. The category honours companies that foster diverse, equitable and inclusive workplaces where employees of all backgrounds are respected, empowered and given equal opportunities to grow.

The dual recognition reflects Vietjet’s long term commitment to placing people at the heart of its growth strategy while cultivating an open, professional and globally connected workplace. It also lands at a timely moment that solidifies the airline’s entry into the Sri Lankan market, with inaugural Colombo – Ho Chi Minh City flight being scheduled for 18 August 2026.

Vietjet currently employs nearly 10,000 employees and experts from more than 68 countries and territories. Almost 30% are young professionals aged between 20 and 30, contributing innovation, creativity and fresh perspectives to the airline’s continued development.

To support long term talent development, Vietjet invests extensively in training and professional development through the Victoria Aviation Academy (VIAA), where employees participate in international standard aviation training, leadership programmes and specialised courses delivered by industry experts.

Employee wellbeing is another priority for Vietjet. In addition to modern workplace facilities such as dining areas, a cinema room, gym, yoga room and community spaces, the airline regularly organises cultural, sports and team building activities that strengthen employee engagement and workplace culture.

With a dynamic, creative and internationally diverse workforce, Vietjet continues to enhance its long term competitiveness as it pursues its vision of becoming a modern, globally connected and people focused airline. For travellers from Sri Lanka, the airline offers connections not only to Vietnam’s largest city but also to top destinations across Asia, Australia, and Europe, via major Vietnamese hubs.

title: Cinnamon Bentota Beach-Signature Selection promises journey of nostalgia | Daily FT
summary:
Wednesday, 15 July 2026 00:04
-     - 7

By Uma Chandrasiri

Sri Lanka’s first ever purpose built beach resort and Geoffrey Bawa’s masterpiece, Cinnamon Bentota Beach-Signature Selection, stands majestic, serenaded by the flowing waters of the Bentota river and the crashing waves of the Indian ocean and invites you to a world of bygone charm, eclectic and unrivalled beauty, highest standards of service excellence and an opportunity to escape into a world where dreams are fulfilled. 

The promise of Cinnamon Bentota Beach-Signature Selection lies in the fusion of the one of the islands’ most beloved beach destinations, proud local heritage, Bawa’s mastery in ‘tropical modernism’, open spaces kissed by natural light, timeless and world renowned Sri Lankan hospitality, views that mesmerise, unparalleled dining experiences and the warmth of her people that elevates a holiday to a cherished memory. 

Dining at this inimitable resort is a masterclass in culinary experience, bold island spices that meld with refined mediterranean flavours, unhurried evenings and the promise of the freshest of the ocean’s treats. The dedicated and highly skilled chefs at the resorts’ main restaurant, Zest, offer delectable Chinese, Indian and Sri Lankan cuisine while their open-air seafood restaurant ‘Sea meats spice’ brings the bounty from the ocean straight to the table. Italian and Mediterranean elegance in cuisine is encapsulated at the intimate L’incontro, its elegant setting promising fine dining, finest selection of wines and connection. The three bars and cafes of the resort, fuze- lobby bar and lounge, Drench pool bar and cafe Comida, offer an exciting array of signature cocktails, fine wines, mocktails, light meals, freshly brewed coffee and the finest Ceylon tea. 

Cinnamon Bentota Beach- Signature Selection is also unique in their highly thoughtful and curated offerings, ranging from a total of 141 premium and luxury rooms and 16 premium and deluxe suites (the famous Geoffrey Bawa suite being the most luxurious and a tribute to the late legend), Kurundu spa- wellness by choice and the fully equipped fitness centre and experiences such as ‘Bloom house’ and ‘Addara hena- farm to fork concept’ and the much valued ‘Play hub’ where the resort staff mind their 3-10 year old guests with fun activities, giving time and space to tired parents to unwind. ‘Bloom house’ is a secluded tropical paradise on the riverbank that allows guests an intimate space away from the main resort to enjoy breathtaking sunsets or indulge in a romantic dinner. ‘Addara hena’, a novel initiative designed to integrate sustainable agriculture into the day-to-day operations of the resort, supplies seasonal, organic vegetables to the resorts’ kitchens. As part of the important concept, the resort has subsequently introduced ‘Ambula’, a rustic mud house built adjoining the resorts’ own miniature paddy field, which offers a unique and memorable experience, especially to the resort’s foreign guests to pick and cook their own addition to lunch or dinner. ‘Addara hena’ is supported by a closed-loop waste management system where garden waste is converted to compost for use on the farm. The resort takes pride in extending their environmental and social responsibility to the community as they share the excess compost with their neighbours.

Having spent a thoughtfully curated day at Cinnamon Bentota Beach- Signature Selection with a media team, it was evident to everyone present, that this architectural marvel of late Geoffrey Bawa was not merely a place of wonder and beauty highlighted by the unique works of Ena De Silva (the creator of the magnificent and vibrant batik ceiling panels at the resorts’ entrance), Laki Senanayake (who built the iconic peacock sculpture in the lobby), the amazing work of Barbara Sansoni in the lobby and the paintings of renowned artist Ismeth Rahim, but more so a place where people go over and beyond, not just to meet but to exceed every expectation of their valued guests. Apart from the high levels of comforts and hospitality offered by every 5-star resort, the uniqueness of Cinnamon Bentota Beach- Signature Selection lies in its heart, in the way its staff give new meaning to customer satisfaction and value addition. 

The resort vastly benefits from its proximity to the Bentota river, especially at times when her guests are barred from the ocean’s rough waters. The river offers opportunities of adrenaline-inducing water sports or softer and slower currents on a guided mangrove boat ride. Apart from the mangrove rides that allow glimpses into the beauty of our southern waterways and wildlife, Cinnamon Bentota Beach-Signature Selection is proud to offer excursions to the iconic country home of Geoffrey Bawa on the banks of the Dedduwa Lake, Lunuganga Estate, and his brother Bevis Bawa’s ethereal brief garden where time stands still. For those seeking a different thrill, the river also offers the ‘live in the moment’ rushes of water skiing, jet skiing, wind surfing, banana boat rides, body boarding, wave runners, tube rides and disco donut rides for families. 

The unique locale of this wondrous resort makes it a coveted venue for destination weddings, either at their elegant ballroom under crystal chandeliers or by the breaking waves of the ocean beneath a canopy of stars. The resort’s lush and spacious gardens further support celebrations, may it be a birthday, mehendi, haldi, or even corporate cocktails at twilight. 

Speaking to Daily FT, Cinnamon Bentota Beach-Signature Selection General Manager Johan Aschan said: “Since joining the company in 2023, my assignment has been to uplift Cinnamon Bentota Beach following its extensive 2019 renovation. Consequently in 2023, we embarked on a turnaround plan which included rolling out a new strategic road map designed to elevate brand perception, resulting in us shifting and rebranding to add a ‘signature selection’ label. Our vision for this unique, refined and sophisticated resort has always been to be the No. 1 luxury beach destination in Sri Lanka.” Under the guidance of Aschan, the team at Cinnamon Bentota Beach- Signature Selection has streamlined internal processes to achieve the culture of ‘service excellence’ by cultivating a high performance mindset centered on ‘unscripted luxury and elite execution’ in all areas of operation. This fostered a transformative employee environment, driving diversity and extensive local engagement with a 30% female participation. 

When asked as to how he differentiates the resort from a Southern 5-star beach hotel, Aschan responded, “Our unique location with the river on one side and the beach front on the other, sets us apart. The resort is sophisticated yet intimate with Bawa’s unique blend of urban chic and tropical modernism. It is perfectly suited to host lavish weddings and events, as well as catering to high-end travellers seeking a bespoke service and an unforgettable travel experience. Our key differentiator, however, is our people who deliver personalised and heartfelt service excellence every day.” 

Cinnamon Bentota Beach - Signature Selection Resort Manager, Sriyangani Dhanapala, told Daily FT that the past two years with the resort have been immensely gratifying with the biggest pull factor being the ability to improve and transform a business towards its vision. 

“Having spent a considerable amount of time investing in our biggest asset, our people, I am not only able to witness heightened business potential but also notable personal growth. In terms of improvements, most of the big-ticket changes have already been implemented such as elevating the brand to a luxury space under the signature selection positioning. We are currently working on a few initiatives aimed towards service excellence and accreditation.” 

Dhanapala further reiterated her general manager’s sentiments when she identified the warmth of their service as one of the unique focal points of the resort. “Our employees are our ambassadors and they are empowered to be independent on the service floor. This creates the magic of our culinary strength, room experiences, and recreational spaces. I believe that the right talent, empowered and groomed well, is a recipe for magic. At Cinnamon Bentota Beach Signature Selection, we are the destination stewards and the storytellers of the region that put Sri Lanka on the map for excellent hospitality. Our attention to detail and guest-centric approach comes straight from the heart as we deliver our promise of the magic that is true Sri Lankan hospitality.”

title: Sri Lanka on show at Luxury Travel Market Asia Pacific in Singapore | Daily FT
summary:
Wednesday, 15 July 2026 00:00
-     - 5

Sri Lanka’s luxury tourism was promoted at the International Luxury Travel Market (ILTM) Asia Pacific 2026, held from 29 June to 2 July 2026 at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore. 

ILTM Asia Pacific brings together luxury travel advisors, tour operators, destinations, hotels and tourism organisations from around the world through a programme of pre-scheduled business appointments and networking opportunities.

A dedicated Sri Lanka pavilion showcased the country’s diverse tourism experiences, including wildlife, wellness and Ayurveda, cultural heritage, luxury accommodation, adventure tourism, and bespoke travel experiences, positioning Sri Lanka as a premier destination for high-value travellers. During the four-day exhibition, the Sri Lankan delegation conducted a series of business meetings with international luxury travel buyers and industry professionals, generating business opportunities and strengthening partnerships with the global travel trade.

The Sri Lanka Pavilion was organised by the Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau and headed by Deputy Director (Marketing), Chinthaka Liyanaarachchi. It featured 15 participating companies: Aahaasa Collection – Aarunya Nature Resort, Aadya Tea Bungalows and Aavya Cove Villas; Abercrombie and Kent Ltd; Cuuraate; Sri Lanka Tailor-Made; Karusan Travels Ltd; Ceylon Roots Sri Lanka (LOLC Holdings PLC); Luxury Holidays Asia Ltd; Meshaun Journeys; Sri Lanka in Style; Siddhalepa Ayurveda Health Resort; Ishq Luxury Villas; Transco Travels; Travel Design by CDC Ltd; Hilton Yala Resort; and Resplendent Ceylon.

The High Commission of Sri Lanka in Singapore coordinated Sri Lanka’s participation and the arrangements for the Sri Lanka Pavilion at ILTM Asia Pacific 2026. During the exhibition, High Commissioner Senarath Dissanayake accompanied by Minister Counsellor (Commercial), Bhagya Abeykoon visited the Sri Lanka pavilion and met with the participating companies conveying appreciation for their exhibitors’ efforts in promoting Sri Lanka’s tourism sector and encouraging them to leverage the Singapore market to forge new business partnerships and enhance Sri Lanka’s visibility as a premier luxury travel destination.
